# QAmcp

> QAmcp is a free, open-source (MIT) tester for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. It connects to a server the way an AI app does and reports, in plain words, what is broken: connection, tool descriptions, safety labels, hidden instructions in tool descriptions, bad-input handling, leaked secrets in error messages, speed, login (OAuth) setup, resources and prompts. Every result is a hard fact (pass or fail, milliseconds, exact matches); no AI judges the results.

How to use it:

- In the browser, no install: https://qamcp.dev/test.html (paste a server link, press Test it)
- In a terminal: `npx qamcp-cli https://your-server.com/mcp` (or `npx qamcp-cli --stdio "your command"` for a local server)
- Before installing someone else's server: `npx qamcp-cli <link> --before-install`
- On every commit: `npx qamcp-cli --install-hook --stdio "npm start"`
- On every pull request: the GitHub Action `QAmcp/qamcp-cli@v0`

Safety: by default it only runs tools the server labels read-only, never runs tools that sound destructive, and sends nothing anywhere except to the server being tested. No tracking, no telemetry.

## Pages

- [Test a server in the browser](https://qamcp.dev/test.html): free, same checks and score as the CLI
- [Directory](https://qamcp.dev/directory.html): public MCP servers tested by QAmcp, with scores and every finding; updated daily
- [How to test an MCP server](https://qamcp.dev/how-to-test-mcp-server.html): a step-by-step checklist (connection, descriptions, safety labels, hidden instructions, bad inputs, leaks)
- [MCP server not working?](https://qamcp.dev/mcp-server-not-working.html): fixes for servers that won't connect or show no tools in Cursor, Claude Desktop or VS Code
- [QAmcp in the terminal](https://qamcp.dev/cli.html): every command and option of npx qamcp-cli
- [How it works](https://qamcp.dev/how-it-works.html): every check and how the 0-100 score is calculated
- [Safety and privacy](https://qamcp.dev/safety.html): what QAmcp touches and what it never does
- [Run it in CI](https://qamcp.dev/ci.html): GitHub Action and other CI systems
- [Sample reports](https://qamcp.dev/samples.html): a deliberately broken server, a login wall, and a perfect score
- [Directory rules](https://qamcp.dev/directory-rules.html): how servers are listed and ranked; scores are never changed for money

- [GitHub: QAmcp/qamcp-cli](https://github.com/QAmcp/qamcp-cli)
